$comment: Embedded Nexus Composer pin. Pins the local 3.16.7 build of the onenexus-team/nexus-composer sidecar branch at commit 4bbac2b7ac3d1c5c5857b839c82ffd582097b618, published as release composer-3.16.7-4bbac2b7 in the private repo sonle5/nexus-composer-builds (the internal org repo has no 3.16.7 release). Downloads need a GITHUB_TOKEN that can read that repo. Only darwin-arm64 is published; other targets ship without Composer.
